look.why: A rich tropical terracotta-orange evoking dappled rainforest canopy light and complementing the golden-orange rosette coat.

size.measure: nose to tail tip, about 2.3 m for a large adult (body 1.1–1.85 m plus 0.45–0.75 m tail per ADW)

habitat.text: Tropical rainforests, flooded wetlands, mangroves and dry forests from Mexico through the Amazon to northern Argentina.

diet.text: Capybaras, peccaries, caimans, river turtles, tapirs and fish—an opportunistic apex ambush predator.

facts.text: The largest cat in the Americas, possessing the strongest bite force relative to body size of any felid.
Unlike most cats, jaguars love water and routinely swim across wide rivers to hunt caimans and turtles.

id.habitat: Hutan hujan tropis, lahan basah, hutan bakau, dan hutan kering dari Meksiko hingga Amazon dan Argentina utara.
id.diet: Kapibara, pekari, kaiman, kura-kura sungai, tapir, dan ikan—predator penyergap puncak yang oportunistis.
facts: Kucing terbesar di benua Amerika dengan kekuatan gigitan terkuat dibanding ukuran tubuhnya di antara semua kucing.
Tidak seperti kebanyakan kucing, jaguar gemar berenang dan rutin menyeberangi sungai besar untuk berburu kaiman dan kura-kura.
